crossRefs.note: Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies…
Yahweh didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of…
For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by Yahweh their God, and will not save them by bow…
The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand…

translations.web: So Yahweh saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven.
translations.bsb: So the LORD saved Israel that day, and the battle moved on beyond Beth-aven.
translations.kjv: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Bethaven.
translations.asv: So Jehovah saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over by Beth-aven.
